children: Overview
Water treatment tech provider's H1 2026 revenue grew 26% yr/yr, driven by paid trials and leases
Gross profit for H1 2026 rose 77% yr/yr as recurring media sales expanded
EBITDA loss narrowed in H1 2026 as company managed operating expenses
Outlook
MYCELX expects to meet FY2026 revenue expectation of $11.0 mln, with 80% booked or contracted
Company anticipates a single-source Middle East contract to support FY2026 revenue forecast
MYCELX sees significant growth potential in 2027, driven by elevated oil prices and project pipeline
Result Drivers
PAID TRIALS AND LEASES - Co said H1 2026 revenue growth was primarily driven by paid trials, equipment leases and recurring media sales
REVENUE MIX - Gross margin improvement reflected revenue mix, with leases and recurring media sales contributing a larger share
PROJECT AWARDS - New contracts and heightened bidding activity in produced water treatment supported results, per management
